family: VT-15 Post-maneuver orbit (ML-FR-006 AC5, ML-FR-010 AC3)
description: Highly elliptical, Molniya-like (conditioning near perigee), ν₀ = 3.141592653589793 rad; apsis-tangential burn Δv_RSW = [0, 200, 0] m/s at t_s = 0 s.
status: Committed before any engine run on it (tolerances.md §4.1 item 1; ML-TASK-018 part C phase 1). Not yet reviewed or approved; immutable once approved, corrections create a new version (plan §6).

constants.source: WGS 84 values as written in docs/architecture/proposed-architecture.md §3 (ML-TASK-011 dataset input; VT-19 primary-source status in docs/verification/l2-references-report.md)

inputs.requestIdNote: requestId = "sha256:" + hex(SHA-256(UTF-8(canonicalRequestPayload(request)))) per contracts-v1.md §7.1, computed with @mission-lab/contracts canonicalRequestPayload and Node crypto SHA-256 (test code only).

model.constantsSource: WGS 84 values as written in docs/architecture/proposed-architecture.md §3 (ML-TASK-011 dataset input; VT-19 primary-source status in docs/verification/l2-references-report.md)
model.units: SI: m, m/s, s, rad, m³/s²
model.time: t_s: elapsed SI seconds from the epoch (contracts-v1.md §2)

producedBy.independence: packages/astrodynamics and packages/simulation not read and not run (ADR-003); references import nothing from the engine.
producedBy.numberFormat: Every number is the shortest decimal that round-trips to the binary64 value; JSON.parse restores the exact binary64. Signs of zero are not preserved (−0 written as 0) except where a value is encoded as {"$number": "-0"}.

method.closedForm: Exact RSW maneuver on the exact binary64 initial state: v_r = r·v/r, v_s = ‖r × v‖/r; E⁺ = ((v_r + ΔvR)² + (v_s + ΔvS)² + ΔvW²)/2 − μ/r; h⁺ = r√((v_s + ΔvS)² + ΔvW²); a⁺ = −μ/(2E⁺); e⁺ = √(1 + 2E⁺h⁺²/μ²); plane rotation δ = atan2(|ΔvW|, v_s + ΔvS). For a tangential burn at an apsis this is the vis-viva form a⁺ = 1/(2/r − (v + Δv)²/μ), e⁺ = |1 − r/a⁺| of tolerances.md §7 VT-15.
method.engineSide: a⁺ = 1/(2/r − v⁺²/μ) and e⁺ = ‖[(v⁺² − μ/r) r − (r·v⁺) v⁺]/μ‖ evaluated by the test in binary64 from the event position_m and velocityAfter_mps.

referenceAccuracy.closedForm: 320-bit evaluation, rounded once: ≤ 1 ulp; for m = T the apsis approximation is second order in the phase error (record §7 VT-15).
